items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER]: Shorty Charlie Baker worked with him. Well, Shorty Charlie Baker wasn't around when we were there. [INTERVIEWEE]: No. He was just coming up.

ctx.x: Well, he got out of music I guess -- we left St. Louis in '25, and I suppose he got out of music

I guess around '30 because he still kept going. So many musicians we meet now who worked with him, that we didn't know, you know, in St. Louis. Yeah. Shorty Charlie Baker worked with him. Well, Shorty Charlie Baker wasn't around when we were there.
No. He was just coming up.
